newsitem.title: UK: BT says 98.5 pct approved MCI pact.
newsitem.headline: BT says 98.5 pct approved MCI pact.

text.p: About 98.5 percent of the 2.3 million shareholders of British Telecommunications plc voted in favour on Tuesday of the company's merger with MCI Communications Corp, BT said.
BT said 99.8 percent of the institutional shareholders approved the $20 billion merger while those 620,000 BT shareholders who voted by proxy approved by a 99 percent majority.

Of those 831 shareholders voting by a show of hands at an extraordinary general meeting in north London, 50 voted against the pact which creates one of the largest telecommunications companies in the world.
Among the concerns expressed by those shareholders voting against the merger were that BT paid too high a price for MCI and that BT executives stood the most to gain from the deal.
